lines.text: As his death drew near, David charged Solomon to be strong and walk in the LORD's ways.
David said the LORD promised that if his descendants walked faithfully, a man of his line would always sit on Israel's throne.
David said Joab had killed Abner and Amasa in peacetime, so Solomon must not let Joab die in peace.
David told Solomon to show loving devotion to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, who stood by him when he fled from Saul.
David was buried in the City of David after reigning forty years, seven in Hebron and thirty-three in Samaria.
